notes.title: Indie Cup Celebration 2023
notes.notes:
Last year we participated in the delightful [url=https://indiecup.net/canada/awards/]Indie Cup Canada '22 Awards [/url] among other neat games. Now Indie Cup is throwing a celebration on Steam we're happy to be a part of. Yes, the event is called[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/indiecup] Indie Cup Celebration[/url].

We have released the first seven levels of Quantum Coherence as a demo for Steam Next Fest. The demo showcases space combat and the BLINC mechanic, as well as providing some insight into the game's lore. Our aim is to pique your curiosity with the demo, leaving you with more questions than answers. Join us on an epic journey by downloading the demo and providing feedback. Don't miss out on being among the first to experience Quantum Coherence

Stay tuned because there's a lot more to come before the game is released this year!

You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/WeroCreative]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://werocreative.com/contact]signup for updates[/url] on our site.

If you haven't done so yet, wish list Quantum Coherence now!

The organizers of Indie Cup are in Ukraine and if you haven't donated to humanitarian cause to help their country, please do so. [url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/02/27/how-to-help-ukraine/]Here's a list of ways to help Ukraine[/url].

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42859912/73ef0c31effd800b475b572e38fd92558a27f5d1.png[/img]

As part of Steam next Fest we've released our demo to curious individuals looking to see what Quantum Coherence is all about. The demo includes the first seven levels of the game to capture the essence of the the Quantum Coherence experience. You'll get a taste of the space combat and BLINC mechanic while also getting some of the lore the game. Hopefully the demo will leave you with more questions than answers.

Our demo release offers a sneak peek into the world of Quantum Coherence, where you'll get a taste of the game's mechanics and narrative. We can't wait to hear your feedback and for you to join us on this epic journey.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to be among the first to play Quantum Coherence. Download the demo today and get ready to experience the ultimate adventure!

Stay tuned because there's a lot more to come before the game is released this year!

You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/WeroCreative]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://werocreative.com/contact]signup for updates[/url] on our site.

If you haven't done so yet, wish list Quantum Coherence now!

notes.title: Beta Play with the Developer
notes.notes:
Join us for a live stream with the developer behind Wero's next game, Quantum Coherence! During this stream, Adam will give us an in-depth look at the making of the game, showcasing its unique features and gameplay mechanics. You'll also have the chance to ask questions and get insights into the creative process behind the game's development.

If there's enough interest we can even show some things from behind the scenes of making the game.
